rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for journalism as the work of gathering, writing, editing, and presenting news.

example.english: They have worked in journalism for ten years, mainly interviewing people and editing news.
example.traditional: 佢做咗十年新聞工作，主要負責採訪同編輯新聞。

rows.note: Use this when focusing specifically on reporting and presenting news rather than the wider journalism profession.

example.english: The journalism covering this incident should stick to the facts and avoid wild speculation.
example.traditional: 呢宗事件嘅新聞報道應該只講事實，唔好亂咁估。
